newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens steady, second-tiers fall.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens steady, second-tiers fall.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 share index opened steady on Tuesday as a weak overnight performance on Wall Street was tempered by firmer bond markets and a rebound in battered UK bank shares, dealers said.
At 0843 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was down 1.5 points to 4,561.3.
Second-liners fared less well. The FTSE 250 was down 10.5 points to 4,471.4.
Losses were limited by steady to firm bond markets, although fears that UK and U.S. interest rates are set to rise could limit any rebound, they said.
